newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - SFE wheat futures rise confirming mkt upturn.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - SFE wheat futures rise confirming mkt upturn.

text.p: Australian wheat futures rose well in healthy trading on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Wednesday in response to Chicago's overnight rise and in confirmation of the market's break-out from its long downtrend.
January 1997 rose by A$3.00 to A$152.00 a tonne on 25 trades while March 1997 also added A$3.00 to A$154.00 on 12 trades.
"(The rise) is a little bit on Chicago but also a lot of hedges are beginning to be lifted," Phil Lindsay of Ord Minnett Jardine Fleming Futures Ltd said.
Tightness in deliverable stocks for futures in Chicago and Kansas worried many that the market had over-reacted on the downside, he said.
Ords' chartists were looking for a rally back to A$169.00 for January 1997, he said.
Good export inquiries for Australian wheat, with a sale of 200,000 tonnes of Australian Standard White to Egypt last week, showed reasonably strong demand, he said.
